gta_teleport.command.on: GTA Teleport is on: teleports from %s blocks, speed %s, height %s, clouds %s. Hold the "Plain teleport" key (Left Alt) for a teleport without the switch
gta_teleport.command.off: GTA Teleport is off (/gtatp on to turn it on)
gta_teleport.config.title: GTA Teleport
gta_teleport.config.speed.tooltip: How fast the whole switch plays. ×2 is twice as fast.
gta_teleport.config.height.tooltip: How high over the ground the camera goes. Auto: 420 blocks with Distant Horizons, otherwise 1.2 × render distance.
gta_teleport.config.clouds.tooltip: Clouds over the parts of the world that aren't drawn yet. Distant Horizons terrain is never covered. Auto: off with an Iris shader pack.
gta_teleport.config.tint.tooltip: Colour of the flashes. Auto gives every player you teleport to their own character.
gta_teleport.config.volume.tooltip: All the switch sounds, on top of the master volume.
gta_teleport.config.jump_volume.tooltip: The boom of every jump and of the landing.
gta_teleport.config.pan_volume.tooltip: The whoosh of the flight across.
gta_teleport.config.wind_volume.tooltip: The wind while the camera is up.
